title: France, UK carry out joint airborne nuclear-strike exercise for first time
summary: France and the UK have conducted their first-ever joint airborne nuclear-strike exercise. This marks a significant shift for France's Strategic Air Forces, which have historically operated autonomously since their inception in the 1960s.

title: Kongsberg demonstrates containerised ‘NSM in a box’
summary: Kongsberg has successfully demonstrated a containerized Naval Strike Missile (NSM) transportation and launch system, dubbed "NSM in a box." This system offers a flexible and mobile solution for deploying NSMs, significantly enhancing strategic options.

title: Space Force shifts into high gear on cislunar warfare, with RFIs coming soon
summary: The Space Force is accelerating its focus on cislunar warfare capabilities, with Requests for Information (RFIs) expected soon. Maj. Gen. Stephen Purdy stated that the service aims to field cislunar capabilities by the end of fiscal year 2029.

title: General Atomics FQ-42 CCA Drone Production Ramp Up To Be Boosted By Boeing Subsidiary
summary: General Atomics is collaborating with Spirit Defense, a Boeing subsidiary, to accelerate the production of FQ-42 Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) drones. This partnership aims to meet the surging demand from the USAF for these fighter drones within the next six years.

title: US Air Force wants AI to assist aerial refueling
summary: The US Air Force is exploring the use of AI to assist with aerial refueling operations. The goal is for AI to automatically analyze camera footage from tankers and provide "hot wash" feedback to crews, improving efficiency and safety.
